instruction: Find and open the medical conditions reference on Drugs.com.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from the drugs.com homepage to the medical conditions reference page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the active URL matches the expected conditions page. This is a simple navigation task similar in complexity to the original natural products database navigation.
metadata.verification_notes: The medical conditions reference (/condition/) is a standard section on drugs.com. Task requires agent to find and navigate to this section from the homepage.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction: The task requires navigating to the medical conditions reference page on Drugs.com, and the evaluator checks that the active tab URL matches 'https://www.drugs.com/condition/'.

Getter logic is correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts the URL from the accessibility tree's Address bar. The config explicitly sets 'goto_prefix' to empty string (""), so the full URL from the address bar will be returned without modification.
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_active_tab compares the actual URL with the expected URL using compare_urls function, which correctly handles URL comparison.
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the single requirement of the instruction - that the user has navigated to and opened the medical conditions reference page.

Previous judge's concern about duplicate protocol was based on misunderstanding: The config DOES explicitly set 'goto_prefix': "" at line 50, so the default 'https://' will NOT be used. The getter will return the URL exactly as shown in the address bar.
